This commit replaces the entire stack\n    to revive kanban as a `gh` CLI extension for Projects v2.\n    \n    - Drop legacy code: api/ (custom GraphQL + REST v3 mix),\n      internal/kanban/ui/ (tview), pkg/{git,markdown,runCmd,stringUtil},\n      cmd/kanban/cmd/ (cobra), and ~/.config/kanban.yml PAT loader.\n    - New architecture under internal/{cli,gh,tui}:\n      * cli/   - alecthomas/kong subcommand parser (`view -u USER -p TITLE`\n        or `-o ORG -p TITLE`, mutually exclusive)\n      * gh/    - cli/go-gh/v2 GraphQL client wrapper, ProjectsV2 board\n        query + updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue mutation +\n        Issue/PR/DraftIssue context fetcher with comments\n      * tui/   - charmbracelet bubbletea + lipgloss model/update/view,\n        Status SingleSelect grouping with No-Status fallback column,\n        per-column viewport scroll and overflow indicators\n        (`↑ N above`, `+ N more`), horizontal column window when too\n        many statuses to fit\n    - Lazy load board fetch via tea.Cmd so the TUI shows a spinner the\n      moment alt-screen switches in, rather than blocking the terminal\n      while a large project paginates.\n    - Auth via `gh auth token` only; PAT config file removed.\n    - Key bindings: h/l columns, j/k cursor, n/b move Status (calls\n      updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue), o open card, O open project,\n      y yank current Issue/PR (body + up to 100 comments) as Markdown\n      to the clipboard for AI prompts (atotto/clipboard, no cgo),\n      R reload, q quit.\n    - Distribution: cli/gh-extension-precompile@v2 in release workflow,\n      binary renamed to `gh-kanban`, .goreleaser.yaml updated to v2\n      schema with linux/darwin/windows × amd64/arm64. Old Homebrew tap\n      pipeline removed. New test workflow runs go vet/build/test on PRs.\n    - Tests: column building (Status grouping + orphan fallback),\n      viewport windowing (top/middle/bottom anchoring), view rendering\n      (loading state, board after load, overflow indicators), and\n      Markdown yank format (Issue with comments, DraftIssue without\n      comments, PR with truncation marker).\n    \n    * feat: support project lookup by number and implement paginated loading\n    \n    Add --number/-N flag for faster project access by ID, skipping title search. This commit replaces the entire stack\n    to revive kanban as a `gh` CLI extension for Projects v2.\n    \n    - Drop legacy code: api/ (custom GraphQL + REST v3 mix),\n      internal/kanban/ui/ (tview), pkg/{git,markdown,runCmd,stringUtil},\n      cmd/kanban/cmd/ (cobra), and ~/.config/kanban.yml PAT loader.\n    - New architecture under internal/{cli,gh,tui}:\n      * cli/   - alecthomas/kong subcommand parser (`view -u USER -p TITLE`\n        or `-o ORG -p TITLE`, mutually exclusive)\n      * gh/    - cli/go-gh/v2 GraphQL client wrapper, ProjectsV2 board\n        query + updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue mutation +\n        Issue/PR/DraftIssue context fetcher with comments\n      * tui/   - charmbracelet bubbletea + lipgloss model/update/view,\n        Status SingleSelect grouping with No-Status fallback column,\n        per-column viewport scroll and overflow indicators\n        (`↑ N above`, `+ N more`), horizontal column window when too\n        many statuses to fit\n    - Lazy load board fetch via tea.Cmd so the TUI shows a spinner the\n      moment alt-screen switches in, rather than blocking the terminal\n      while a large project paginates.\n    - Auth via `gh auth token` only; PAT config file removed.\n    - Key bindings: h/l columns, j/k cursor, n/b move Status (calls\n      updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue), o open card, O open project,\n      y yank current Issue/PR (body + up to 100 comments) as Markdown\n      to the clipboard for AI prompts (atotto/clipboard, no cgo),\n      R reload, q quit.\n    - Distribution: cli/gh-extension-precompile@v2 in release workflow,\n      binary renamed to `gh-kanban`, .goreleaser.yaml updated to v2\n      schema with linux/darwin/windows × amd64/arm64. Old Homebrew tap\n      pipeline removed. New test workflow runs go vet/build/test on PRs.\n    - Tests: column building (Status grouping + orphan fallback),\n      viewport windowing (top/middle/bottom anchoring), view rendering\n      (loading state, board after load, overflow indicators), and\n      Markdown yank format (Issue with comments, DraftIssue without\n      comments, PR with truncation marker).\n    \n    * feat: support project lookup by number and implement paginated loading\n    \n    Add --number/-N flag for faster project access by ID, skipping title search. Consolidate bootstrap to fetch project metadata and first 100 items in a single GraphQL query, then stream follow-up pages incrementally. Improve loading UI with centered placeholder, progress badge showing loaded/total items while paging, and status message in footer. Refactor clipboard from transitive to direct dependency. Update types to ProjectSpec, BootstrapResult, ItemsPage for cleaner async handling.\n    \n    * ci: pin GitHub Actions to specific commit Faster than --project because it skips the search query.\"`\n}\n\nfunc (c *ViewCmd) Run() error {\n\tif c.Project != \"\" && c.Number != 0 {\n\t\treturn errors.New(\"--project and --number are mutually exclusive\")\n\t}\n\n\tparams := gh.InitParams{\n\t\tUserLogin: c.User,\n\t\tOrgLogin:  c.Org,\n\t}\n\tif params.UserLogin == \"\" && params.OrgLogin == \"\" {\n\t\tdetected, err := gh.DetectOwnerFromCurrentRepo()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"could not auto-detect owner from current repository (%w); specify --user/-u or --org/-o\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tparams = detected\n\t}\n\n\tclient, err := gh.NewClient(params)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tif errors.Is(err, gh.ErrInvalidClientType) {\n\t\t\treturn errors.New(\"specify exactly one of --user/-u or --org/-o\")\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tspec := gh.ProjectSpec{\n\t\tTitle:  c.Project,\n\t\tNumber: c.Number,\n\t}\n\n\tif spec.Title == \"\" && spec.Number == 0 {\n\t\tprojects, err := client.ListProjects()\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"list projects: %w\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch len(projects) {\n\t\tcase 0:\n\t\t\tfmt.Printf(\"No projects found for %s.\\n\", client.Login)\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tcase 1:\n\t\t\tspec.Number = projects[0].Number\n\t\tdefault:\n\t\t\tsel, err := pickProject(projects)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif sel == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tspec.Number = sel.Number\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tlabel := specLabel(spec)\n\n\tmodel := tui.New(client, spec, label)\n\tprogram := tea.NewProgram(model, tea.WithAltScreen())\n\tif _, err := program.Run(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc specLabel(spec gh.ProjectSpec) string {\n\tif spec.Number > 0 {\n\t\tif spec.Title != \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%q (#%d)\", spec.Title, spec.Number)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"#%d\", spec.Number)\n\t}\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"%q\", spec.Title)\n}\n","numLines":91,"startLine":1,"totalLines":91}}}

When not nil, the cursor will be shown at the specified\n\t// position.\n\tCursor *Cursor\n\n\t// BackgroundColor when not nil, sets the terminal background color.
